<div class="home-section">
  <h2>About</h2>
  <p>
    I'm an economist interested in political economy, public policy,
    development, housing, and labor economics. My academic research asks how
    policies, ranging from border enforcement to regime change to school
    quality, impact people (often in ways that policymakers never intended or
    the public misunderstands). In answering these questions, I use a variety
    of quasi-experimental tools (e.g., synthetic control, regression
    discontinuity, and difference-in-differences) to build credible
    counterfactuals and better understand their causal effects.
  </p>
  <p>
    I'm a Senior Consultant at
    <a href="https://www.rpcconsulting.com/">Research &amp; Planning Consultants</a>,
    where I apply the same toolkit to economic questions in litigation. Before
    that, I was an economist at <a href="https://www.rand.org/">RAND</a> for
    six years. Ph.D., University of Oklahoma (Boomer Sooner).
  </p>
</div>

    <div class="meta">with Robin Grier and Kevin Grier · under review</div>
    <p class="abstract">
      In 1993, Operation Hold the Line put a wall of Border Patrol agents
      between El Paso and Ciudad Juárez. Crossings collapsed — and so did
      incomes, house values, and business growth on the U.S. side. The costs
      to El Paso swamped the benefits.

<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById("walk-canvas");
  if (!canvas || !canvas.getContext) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var N = 11, dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  var walks = [], W = 0, H = 0, STEPS = 0;

  function noise() { // approx gaussian
    return (Math.random() + Math.random() + Math.random() - 1.5);
  }
  function makeWalk() {
    var vals = [], y = (0.12 + 0.76 * Math.random()) * H;
    for (var i = 0; i < STEPS; i++) {
      y += noise() * H * 0.006;
      vals.push(y);
    }
    return vals;
  }
  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * dpr;
    H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight * dpr;
    STEPS = Math.max(80, Math.floor(W / (6 * dpr)));
    walks = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) walks.push(makeWalk());
    draw();
  }
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1 * dpr;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.07)";
    var dx = W / (STEPS - 1);
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var j = 0; j < STEPS; j++) {
        var x = j * dx, y = walks[i][j];
        if (j === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  function tick() {
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      var vals = walks[i];
      vals.shift();
      vals.push(vals[vals.length - 1] + noise() * H * 0.006);
    }
    draw();
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  resize();
  if (!reduced) setInterval(tick, 90);
})();
</script>
